researchQuestion: What predicate drives SelectAndClassify P1 vs P1b assignment?
answer: P1/P1b assignment is primarily rawIQR-driven (spread), with rawMean providing independent complementary stabilization. rawIQR dominates 10x in normalized terms. A rank-based rawIQR+rawMean composite yields consistent P1>P1b direction across all N.
supportedFindings: rawIQR is strongest P1/P1b discriminator (10x normalized dominance)
P1 selects higher rawIQR profiles in pooled IsHi-pass population
rawIQR alone not uniformly stable per-N (jackknife 1/3 N)
Rank-based rawIQR+rawMean composite improves per-N stability (2/3 N)
Composite yields consistent P1>P1b direction across all 3 N
hypotheses: rawIQR may encode dominant SAC/P1 spread discriminator
rawMean may stabilize rawIQR ambiguity across N
P1/P1b assignment may depend on composite profile-shape signal
notClaimed: physical N-boundary or physical interpretation of N
new model variables or correction classes
physical length, c, GR, spacetime, or cosmology derivation
